expectations.text: Resolves every setting in one documented order: flag, then env var, then project config, then user config, then built-in default
expectations.evidence: "flag > environment variable > project file > user config > built-in default"

expectations.text: Makes an explicit token from a flag or env var beat the stored profile and prints a stderr notice when it overrides a logged-in account
expectations.evidence: "using SM_TOKEN, ignoring logged-in profile acme-eu"

expectations.text: Gives every global setting both a flag and an env var under one prefix (such as `SM_PROFILE`, `SM_API_URL`, `SM_NO_INPUT`)
expectations.evidence: Env table with SM_ prefix and matching flags; token and config dir exceptions justified.

expectations.text: Offers named profiles for accounts, orgs, regions and self-hosted base URLs
expectations.evidence: Profiles for regions, org and self-hosted URL.

expectations.text: Allows `.smrc` to bind a project directory to a profile only as a file holding no secret; the token leaves the project file
expectations.evidence: ".sm.toml... Never holds Tokens"

expectations.text: Stores config in the OS-expected location (XDG base directories, `%APPDATA%`)
expectations.evidence: XDG and `%APPDATA%\sm\config.toml`

expectations.text: Locks the config and credential store against concurrent writes so parallel agents refreshing one token cannot corrupt it
expectations.evidence: Exclusive advisory lock and atomic write refresh algorithm.

expectations.text: Honors `HTTPS_PROXY`, `NO_PROXY` and a custom CA bundle rather than offering a skip-verification flag
expectations.evidence: "There is no `--insecure` flag."

expectations.text: Never requires the token as a flag value; accepts it from env var, file or stdin
expectations.evidence: "A flag is not allowed (leaks via `ps`)"

expectations.text: Makes `sm fleets create` send one idempotency key per invocation and reuse it on automatic retries
expectations.evidence: "generates a random idempotency key... reuses that key on every automatic retry"

expectations.text: Accepts `--idempotency-key` so a script that reruns the command is safe
expectations.evidence: "`--idempotency-key` accepts the caller's own key."

expectations.text: Retries transient failures automatically with bounded backoff, honoring `Retry-After`
expectations.evidence: "1 s, 2 s and 4 s plus jitter. It honors `Retry-After`."

expectations.text: Pins each CLI release to an explicit API version and offers an override flag
expectations.evidence: "pinned to one API version... `SM_API_VERSION` / `--api-version`"

expectations.text: Reflects which configuration source won in `auth status`
expectations.evidence: "`sm auth status` shows the source of the selection"; `sm config explain`.
